annotations.title: List Registered Apps & SDK Integration Guides

description: List all registered websites and mobile apps in the workspace with active subscriber counts, current credit balance, and optional framework SDK installation snippets (when include_sdk_framework is set). Use this tool first as a prerequisite to obtain a valid app_id before calling send_push_notification, schedule_push_notification, update_app_branding, delete_app, configure_inapp_banner, or configure_rss_autopush; do not use it to inspect individual subscriber devices (use list_subscribers instead). Read-only operation requiring PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY with 0 credit cost; when include_sdk_framework is passed ('html', 'nextjs', 'laravel', 'wordpress', 'flutter'), each app entry also includes ready-to-paste SDK setup code. Returns JSON { tenant_name, credits_balance, total_apps, apps: [{ id, site_name, site_url, active_subscribers, sdk_guide }] }.

app_id.description: Optional specific app_id (format app_xxxx) to filter and inspect in detail

include_sdk_framework.description: Optional target stack ('html', 'nextjs', 'laravel', 'wordpress', or 'flutter') to include copy-paste SDK & service worker installation code

name: list_apps
